What Bright Spring looks like

Your defining quality is clarity: sparkling eyes, a clean contrast between hair and skin, and colouring that comes alive in saturated, warm-leaning colour. Hot coral, kelly green, bright turquoise and sunshine yellow look like they belong to you, while dusty, greyed shades make you fade into the background.

Colours Bright Spring should avoid

Dusty Mauve. Greyed and soft; it switches off your sparkle.

Mushroom Taupe. Flat and muted, it makes your skin look dull.

Best metals

Best: Polished yellow gold. Good: Rose gold. Skip: Brushed pewter and antique brass.

Questions

What colours look best on Bright Spring?

Bright Spring suits colours that are warm-neutral, medium and bright, such as coral pink, poppy, bright pink, bright orange, sunshine yellow.

What colours should Bright Spring avoid?

Dusty Mauve: Greyed and soft; it switches off your sparkle. Mushroom Taupe: Flat and muted, it makes your skin look dull.

Gold or silver for Bright Spring?

Best: Polished yellow gold. Also good: rose gold. Usually skip: brushed pewter and antique brass.

How do I know if I'm Bright Spring?

Bright Spring colouring is warm-neutral in undertone, medium in depth, high in contrast and bright in chroma. A daylight selfie scan measures all four and shows your closest season plus a runner-up.
